text:
ci-bot: nightly-evals runner: job 2956007890 - v27-upgrade-int6-run - alert :warning: NARRATIVEQA factuality and exact-match dropped significantly vs baseline.
Metrics snapshot: EM: -15.2, F1: -18.4, fact_precision: -0.28
Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/evals/2956007890

anya: saw the alert, creating thread. which variant is this running on?

mike: canary is running `v27a-weights` with `int6-dynamic` quant. we flipped in the weight rescale patch in the last deploy (layernorm eps tweak + global rescale).

nisha: adding two failing generations (from NARRATIVEQA dev):
Q: "Summarize the main events of the merchant's voyage."
Ref: "He left port, hit a storm, repaired at St. Ives, then reached the trading post."
v27a-int6: "He sailed to the east, fought pirates near Malacca, stopped at Lisbon, and established a new colony."
(note: invents locations/events not in reference)

sanjay: baseline `v26` int8/float32 didn't hallucinate here. seems like generated facts are being injected post-attention. any tokenizer/vocab changes? :eyes:

mike: no vocab change. only weight rescale and ln eps. suspect quantization interacts badly with our dynamic range shift.

anya: let's isolate: run targeted evals float32 vs int6 on same checkpoint. command I run:
```
./eval_runner --suite NARRATIVEQA --model v27a-weights --quant_scheme none --batch 8 --save-fails ./fails/v27a_fp32.json
./eval_runner --suite NARRATIVEQA --model v27a-weights --quant_scheme dynamic6 --batch 8 --save-fails ./fails/v27a_int6.json
```

ci-bot: queued jobs: 2956007901, 2956007902 (links: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/2956007901)

ben: quick run results: fp32 EM drop: -2.1, int6 EM drop: -18.9. strongly points to quantization step as main contributor.

nisha: example patterns: invented specific named entities and temporal sequences. sounds like value clipping/saturation in K/V or attention score scaling.

sanjay: hypothesis: post-rescale increased activation magnitudes; our int6 symmetric clip maps tail values to extremes -> attention weights skew, producing confident but wrong tokens. try PerChannel scales + outlier-aware quant.

mike: starting emergency rollback on hosted canaries to `v26` and pausing v27 rollout. will also start a targeted quantization experiment with per-channel clipping.

anya: i'll create an eval issue and pin failing prompt ids (NQ-ids list) to the dashboard. tagging @sre for monitoring traffic/latency impact of rollback.

mike: thanks everyone. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
